import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,base64,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd()
def wr(n,s):
 z=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),n],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert z.returncode==0
res=json.loads(Path('reservation.json').read_text());d=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());lit=json.loads(Path('literal-provenance.json').read_text());assert set(d)==set(map(str,res['ids']))==set(lit) and len(d)==20
for mid,x in lit.items():
 raw=base64.b64decode(x['raw_base64']);assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==x['raw_sha256'] and raw.endswith(b'\n');assert json.loads(raw)==x['row'];assert hashlib.sha256(x['statement_raw_token'].encode()).hexdigest()==x['statement_raw_token_sha256'];assert json.loads(x['statement_raw_token'])==x['statement_utf8']==d[mid]['literal_statement'];assert hashlib.sha256(x['statement_utf8'].encode()).hexdigest()==x['statement_utf8_sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(Path('TASK.txt').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='62de808e0bb7182ff3f2905a533d2450916a38266195e7955260245184def0c4'
charges=[json.loads(x) for x in Path('search-charges.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()];budget=json.loads(Path('search-budget.json').read_text());assert budget['calls_used']==len(charges)==2 and budget['queries_used']==sum(len(x['queries']) for x in charges)==6
for c in charges:
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(c['plan']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==c['plan_sha256']
prev='0'*64;events=[]
for raw in Path('guard-ledger.jsonl').read_bytes().splitlines(keepends=True):
 x=json.loads(raw);assert x['seq']==len(events) and x['previous']==prev;events.append(x);prev=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
for x in events:
 if x['event']=='success':assert hashlib.sha256(Path(x['destination']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==x['sha256']
brief=Path('ACTUALBRIEF.md').read_text()+'\n## Exact fixed20 dispositions\n\n'
for mid in res['ids']:
 x=d[str(mid)];brief+=f"- **{mid} — {x['disposition']}**: {x['ordinary_assessment']}\n"
brief+='\nEach entry in results.json separately records literal, original-source, final-source, ordinary, prior, novelty, significance, family, formal, independent, procedure and acceptance gates. All formal and independent gates are NOT_RUN; all acceptance gates remain ROOT_ONLY.\n'
wr('ACTUALBRIEF.md',brief)
wr('PROCEDURAL-DEVIATIONS.json',json.dumps({'serialization_errors':[{'call':1,'exact_error':'ReferenceError: btoa is not defined','effect':'No shell/network/counter mutation; full response retained in orchestration memory'},{'call':1,'exact_error':'ReferenceError: TextEncoder is not defined','effect':'No shell/network/counter mutation; next own-lane run saved full exact response'}],'output_truncations':'Initial instruction/history outputs fully saved under runner; all inherited denials recovered in contiguous ranges; relevant dispositions recovered. Source text reads have exact bounded ranges in inventory. Some later tool returns contain receipt input rather than concise output, all originals retained.','network_guard_budget_breaches_observed':[],'scientific_limit':'No independent certification of mathematics, prior art, significance or resource peaks.'},indent=2)+'\n')
receipts=[]
for p in sorted(lane.glob('*.receipt.json')):
 r=json.loads(p.read_text());receipts.append({'path':p.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'exit':r['exit'],'killed':r['killed'],'wall_s':r['wall_s'],'peak_sampled_group_rss_bytes':r['sampled_group_rss_peak_bytes'],'samples':r['samples'],'affinity':r['affinity'],'cpu_limit_s':r['cpu_limit_s'],'child_cpu_cumulative_s':r['child_cpu_cumulative_s']})
wr('RESOURCE-INVENTORY.json',json.dumps({'completed_receipts_at_creation':receipts,'terminal_later_receipts':['documentary_final_check.receipt.json','finalize_manifest.receipt.json'],'limitations':'Sampling misses transients; native searchCPU/RSS and separate writer peaks unavailable. Bootstrap/standalone before/after cap exceptions. No universal compliance claim. All local subprocesses synchronous and reaped.','limits':'affinity2 childCPU115 supervisor120 AS6GiB sampledgroupRSS6GiB deadline130 outer140 arena2'},indent=2)+'\n')
wr('DOCUMENTARY-CHECK.json',json.dumps({'original_bindings_checked':20,'exact_result_ids':res['ids'],'task_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path('TASK.txt').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'guard_chain_events':len(events),'guard_tail_sha256':prev,'search_calls':2,'search_queries':6,'scope':'Documentary hashes/bindings only; NOT mathematics/checker/formal validation'},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Documentary bindings20; task SHA correct; guard chain14events; search continuity2calls6queries; no mathematical computation')
